description: Canonical machine context for Arden and other AI tools. Not a visual roadmap copy: short contract of version, hard architecture rules, accepted work, and next actions.

architectureRules.rule: createExpense() is the only production entry point for new expenses
Training mode requires explicit user confirmation for every new expense; Assistant mode is not enabled
Ledger accounts are the source of truth for money on accounts; funds and plans are not reconciliation targets
Funds are allocation of own money, not accounts
Credit limit is not own money and is not a fund
fundId on an expense is optional
Personal and Business wallets remain separate ledgers with different fields
AI proposes and ranks; the user decides duplicates and confirmations

acceptance: Store behaves exactly as before, aliases and cross-alphabet search intact
Category searches and suggests while typing, list depends on the wallet
A new category, expense purpose, object or customer can be created from the form
Popularity follows real usage from the Ledger
Old expenses open for editing without losing values

accepted.item: Store searchable combobox and merchant learning prep
Expense entry from Personal and Business

inProgress.note: attachSmartSelect(input, {source, searchFields, displayField, aliases, popularity, allowCreate, onCreate, onSelect}); UX only, createExpense, Gateway, Training mode, duplicate protection and Ledger untouched. Picking a row dispatches `change`, so existing field logic keeps working.
fields: category (was <select> in manExp/modal/editRow/valetTeach, now searchable; create goes through ensureCategory)
expense purpose (usage inside the category plus presets)
business object and customer (from business ledger rows)
inProgress.popularitySource: confirmed Ledger rows via directoryUsage(), so old data ranks correctly and no migration is needed
inProgress.notConverted: .as-cat and .as-exp inside proposal cards (short lists in re-rendered rows)

inProgress.note: AI mode (Assistant disabled), free cash rules, funds, credit limits
Only env variable names exist locally; secrets are never published here

doNotDoNow: new major features before v53 acceptance
separate bridge project beyond this JSON
nextActions: Stabilize current version: accept UI_BUILD 53 (SmartSelect on category, expense, object, customer)
Implement the Settings tab with Assistant disabled
Create the next stable release checkpoint
Later: receipts as sourceOperation through LLM and Gateway
focus: Do not add major new features; stabilize the current version first

sync.forArden: At the start of a Wallet discussion, fetch this JSON (contextVersion) and treat architectureRules as hard constraints. Use the roadmap for human detail. Chat never overrides this file.
